subject: Quick fit questions & 3-slot demo proposal
messages:
From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: maya@novaretail.com
Date: 2027-07-26T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Quick fit questions & 3-slot demo proposal

Hi Maya —

Thanks for signing up this morning and for checking out Redwood. I’d love to run a short demo to show the areas most relevant to Nova Retail, but first a few quick fit questions so we can tailor the walkthrough: 

- Primary use case: customer chat, search, summarization, or batch generation?
- Expected volume: rough monthly tokens / API calls (ballpark is fine) and any burst patterns (Black Friday/day-of-sales spikes)?
- Concurrency: approximate number of concurrent sessions or users at peak?
- Typical prompt length and expected output length (tokens)
- Timeline for a pilot / POC (target month)
- Any security/compliance gating (SSO, SCIM, VPC, SOC2 evidence) we should prepare?

If that looks good, here are three slots I can offer next week (all PDT):
- Thu Jul 29 09:00–09:30
- Thu Jul 29 14:00–14:30
- Fri Jul 30 11:00–11:30

If none work, tell me a couple of windows that do and I’ll coordinate.

Also noting: we have a short intro deck I can attach and I can loop in an AE for pricing/next steps if you’d like.

Cheers,

— Laura Bennett
SDR | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
(415) 555-0182

Attachment: none in this message
From: Maya Singh <maya@novaretail.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-07-26T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick fit questions & 3-slot demo proposal

Hi Laura —

Great to meet you (virtually). Quick answers below: 

- Primary use case: customer support assistant + automated summarization of long ticket threads; later expand to product description generation for marketing.
- Expected volume: we’re targeting ~1.2M tokens/month initially; on heavy promo days we could see ~3–4x short bursts over a 6–12 hour window.
- Concurrency: peak concurrent active users ~40–60 (web chat agents + customers).
- Typical prompt length: ~50–80 tokens; outputs vary 80–200 tokens.
- Timeline: aim to run a pilot in August with a 6–8 week evaluation.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 is required; SSO (Okta) would be ideal; no air-gapped/on-prem requirement at this time.

Decision-maker: Ramesh Iyer (CTO) will be on the call.

All three slots on Jul 29–30 are tricky for us — could we do Mon Aug 02 at 15:00 PDT instead? If that works, please send a calendar invite and the intro deck ahead of time.

Thanks,
Maya
Head of ML Platforms
Nova Retail
maya@novaretail.com
Phone: +1 415-555-2199
